text: The Dental Treatment I had in Bangkok was very thorough, the surgeon did a fantastic job and I felt totally comfortable the entire time. The location felt more like a 5 star hotel than a Hospital and the service provided by Intermedisol was better than I could have hoped for. The icing on the cake was the cost; it all ended up costing me less than I would have paid if having the surgery done by my local Dentist

I initially booked a thread lift through Intermedisol, I contacted a number of places however the informative timely response lead me to feel I was in good hands and I thought correctly. I had also originally booked a consultation with the view to having blepharoplasty (upper eyelid reduction) with another surgeon however I was not fully comfortable and therefore contacted Patrik at Intermedisol for information. Patrik was extremely efficient and there for both my initial consultation and procedure. I felt immediately at ease which is imperative when having any kind of surgery especially when doing so abroad. I would whole heartedly recommend Intermedisol to anyone considering surgery in Thailand.

My wife and I have both had the pleasure of using the services of Intermedisol in Bangkok. Although initially apprehensive about heading to Bangkok for medical and dental procedures we would be happy to recommend Intermedisol to anyone looking at having a procedure. Their service and care from arrival to departure was exemplary. We have recommended Intermedisol to our own friends who have also had an amazing experience.
John & Heidi. Queensland Australia
